title: Term Life Insurance Face Decreases: Policy Fee Share for Whole Life Insurance and Universal Life Insurance Owners
content:
The policy fee share in the premium released by a Term Life Insurance face decrease follows the owner's other Ashgrove life policies, as recorded under Whole Life Insurance and Universal Life Insurance:

> Nothing of the fee is charged when the owner holds both an in-force Ashgrove whole life policy and an in-force Ashgrove universal life policy; one half of it when the owner holds exactly one of the two in force; and the whole of it otherwise.

| Owner's in-force permanent policies | Share |
|---|---|
| whole life and universal life | nothing |
| one of the two | one half (0.5) |
| neither | the whole fee |

**Hypothetical.** A difference in fee before sharing of 10.00 between the current and requested faces counts as 5.00 for an owner holding one in-force Ashgrove whole life policy, as nothing for an owner holding both kinds, and as 10.00 for an owner holding neither. A permanent policy that is lapsed or surrendered does not count.
